documents.title: Issuance Of Corrigendum To The Notice Of Extra Ordinary General Meeting No. 01/2026 27 To Be Held On October 29, 2026.

Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On Friday, October 23, 2026 - Substitution Of Proposed Allottees And Issuance Of Corrigendum To The Notice Of Extra Ordinary General Meeting No. 01/2026 27 Of D. P. Abhushan Limited
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: D.P. Abhushan Limited presented its Q1 FY27 financial performance, reporting a 58% year-on-year increase in total revenue to INR 853.63 crores. Operating EBITDA grew 70% to INR 93.99 crores with margins expanding by 80 basis points to 11.01%. Growth was supported by strong demand during the summer wedding season and festive occasions like Akshaya Tritiya, alongside a 52% same-store sales growth. The company is advancing its expansion strategy by finalizing store locations in Jabalpur and Dahod, targeting a long-term goal of 51 stores.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting approximately 10% volume growth going forward.
guidance.quote: Broadly, we are targeting around 10% volume growth going forward.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting around 10% volume growth internally for both FY27 and FY28.
guidance.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

guidance.claim: The company targets annual top-line growth of approximately 25% to 30% through 2030.
guidance.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

guidance.claim: Management targets an EBITDA margin of around 6% to 6.5% for FY27.
guidance.quote: Our margin guidance will be around 6% to 6.5%, EBITDA margin.

guidance.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins to reach between 8% and 8.5% by 2030.
guidance.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

guidance.claim: Revenue is planned at around INR 4,800 crores for FY27 and INR 5,500 crores for the next year.
guidance.quote: So FY27 and FY28, the revenue we are planning around like 20%, 25% growth. So INR4,800 crores, and the next year will be INR5,500 crores.

guidance.claim: The company aims to reach a total of around 51 stores by 2030.
guidance.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: Q1 FY27 total revenue grew 58% year-on-year to INR 853.63 crores, supported by festive demand and the summer wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We delivered healthy performance in the first quarter, with revenue growing 58% year on year, supported by festive occasions such as Akshaya Tritiya and the onset of the summer wedding season.

demand_outlook.claim: In Q1 FY27, the company recorded a store footfall-to-conversion ratio of 81% and an average ticket size of approximately Rs. 1,57,000.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q1 FY27, footfall at our stores was encouraging, and the footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81%, showing strong buying intent and effective in-store engagement.

demand_outlook.claim: Wedding-related purchases accounted for 62% of sales during Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In terms of product category mix, wedding related purchases remained the largest contributor, accounting for 62% of the sales during the quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer demand remained healthy across markets during the quarter, supported by consumption-led and investment-led purchases.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer demand remained healthy across our markets during the quarter, supported by both consumption-led and investment-led purchases.

demand_outlook.claim: Old gold exchange contributed approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Following recent government announcements and heightened customer awareness, participation in gold exchange transactions strengthened further, with old gold exchange contributing approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that wedding-led purchases and relationship-driven markets continue to show resilient demand despite elevated gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Even in periods of elevated gold prices, we continue to see jewellery demand remain resilient, especially in wedding-led purchases and relationship-driven markets like ours.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising gold prices have pushed consumers toward lighter designs, daily-wear gold, studded jewellery, and minimalist designs.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising gold prices have pushed consumers toward lighter designs. Daily-wear gold, studded jewellery, and minimalist designs are gaining popularity

demand_outlook.claim: Demand can be temporarily affected by seasonality, with months like June and July seeing relatively lower demand before picking up from Raksha Bandhan onwards.
demand_outlook.quote: That said, demand can be temporarily affected by seasonality. For instance, the wedding season has recently concluded, and months like June and July typically see relatively lower demand. However, we expect demand to pick up again from Raksha Bandhan onwards.

demand_outlook.claim: Volume growth declined by around 20% overall in FY26 due to high gold prices and volatility impacting affordability.
demand_outlook.quote: On the volume side, we actually saw a decline of around 20% overall. This trend was largely in line with the broader industry, where volume growth remained under pressure due to high gold prices.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has finalized new showroom locations in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and Dahod, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Under this roadmap, we have successfully finalized the locations for new showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and Dahod, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming Dahod showroom will span roughly 3,200 sq. ft. under the Company-Owned Company-Operated model.
capex_expansion.quote: The Dahod showroom will be approximately 3,200 sq. ft. and will mark our strategic entry into the Gujarat market.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jabalpur showroom will span roughly 3,750 sq. ft. as the company's first Franchisee-Owned Company-Operated store.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second showroom, in Jabalpur, will be approximately 3,750 sq. ft. and will be our first Franchisee-Owned Company-Operated model showroom.

capex_expansion.claim: The company aims to reach a total of 51 stores, with a majority under the COCO model.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, Vikas here, our overall plan remains broadly unchanged we aim to reach a total of 51 stores, and the majority of these will continue to be under the Company-Owned, Company-Operated (COCO) model.

capex_expansion.claim: Locations for upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur and Dahod have been finalized.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully finalized locations for its upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh and Dahod, Gujarat, with all key agreements, approvals, and necessary formalities completed.

capex_expansion.claim: The showroom network reached 12 after the successful inauguration of a new showroom in Dhar following expansion in Ratlam.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, the Company further strengthened its footprint in Central India with the successful inauguration of a new s in Dhar, following the expansion in Ratlam earlier in the year, taking the total showroom network to 12.

capex_expansion.claim: For the current year, the company has planned to open three to four new COCO stores alongside franchisee additions.
capex_expansion.quote: For this year, we have planned to open three to four new stores. Additionally, we have already finalized one franchisee and will be opening one franchise store as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Planned expansion targets regions including Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Chhattisgarh, and Maharashtra.
capex_expansion.quote: Going ahead, we aim to expand our footprints in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, through a disciplined, research-led approach backed by detailed regional analysis, customer preferences.

margins_costs.claim: The company targets to increase its overall studded mix from 6%-7% currently to 12%-15% by March 2028.
margins_costs.quote: As of now our business is doing like between 6% to 7% of the studded mix. And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

margins_costs.claim: Full year EBITDA margins improved to 7.61%, representing an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR309.7 crores, reflecting a strong growth of 77% YoY, with EBITDA margins improving to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25.

margins_costs.claim: Full year PAT margins improved to 5.20%, an expansion of 180 basis points over FY25.
margins_costs.quote: PAT stood at INR211.8 crores, delivering a robust growth of 88% YoY, with PAT margins improving to 5.20%, an expansion of 180 basis points over FY25.

margins_costs.claim: Approximately 28% to 30% of inventory gains were reflected in the books for FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Approximately 28% to 30% of the inventory gains have been reflected in our books.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins are expected to maintain approximately 10% to 11% going forward.
margins_costs.quote: As far as gross margins are concerned, we expect the business to maintain approximately 10% to 11%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company registered overall same-store sales growth of 52% during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Our same-store sales growth stood at 52% on an overall basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Gold revenue grew 59% year-on-year to INR 781 crores in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Gold revenue increased from INR491 crores in Q1 FY26 to INR781 crores in Q1 FY27. This is reflecting a growth of 59% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Silver revenue grew 150% year-on-year from INR 16 crores in Q1 FY26 to INR 40 crores in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Silver, one of the segments, which is growing drastically, it has grown as compared to Q1 FY26 where we were having INR16 crores to INR40 crores in Q1 FY27, registering a strong growth of 150% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Total retail store area stood at approximately 53,650 square feet.
orders_capacity.quote: Our total retail store area stood at ~53,650 sq. ft. supporting our growing scale of operations.

orders_capacity.claim: Average revenue delivered was ~INR 7.6 lakhs per sq. ft. and ~INR 339 crores per store for FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: On the productivity front, we delivered an average revenue of ~INR7.6 lakhs per sq. ft. and ~INR339 crores per store for FY26, reflecting strong store-level performance and efficient utilization of retail space.

orders_capacity.claim: Overall customer conversion rate remained largely stable at approximately 82% to 83%.
orders_capacity.quote: Our store-level conversion remains strong, with key stores such as Ratlam and Ratlam II delivering higher-than-average conversion levels, while overall conversion has remained largely stable at ~82%–83%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company utilizes exchange-led gold procurement, gold metal loans, and MCX hedging to manage gold price volatility and support working capital efficiency.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to leverage exchange led procurement of gold, gold metal loan, and hedging mechanisms on the commodity exchange platform to mitigate gold price volatility, support margin stability, and improve working capital efficiency.

capital_allocation.claim: The QIP plan has been postponed and put on hold due to unfavorable market conditions.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we are planning to undertake a QIP; however, we have currently put it on hold as market conditions are not favourable. As a result, we have not proceeded with it yet.

capital_allocation.claim: Expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 will be executed through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: As far as our expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 are concerned, they will be executed through internal accruals as well.

capital_allocation.claim: More than 90% to 95% of company investments are deployed in inventory.
capital_allocation.quote: If you look at our balance sheet, more than 90% to 95% of our investment is in inventory.

risks_headwinds.claim: The increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the recent government announcement and increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 has introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity, the long-term fundamentals of the sector remain intact, supported by India’s cultural affinity for gold, wedding and festive led demand, rising formalisation, omnichannel adoption.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that customs duty changes and comments regarding mindful spending practices have been a point of industry-wide discussion.
risks_headwinds.quote: Over the past few weeks, there has also been industry-wide discussion around the recent customs duty changes and the Honourable Prime Minister’s comments regarding mindful spending practices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gold prices were volatile during the last quarter due to geopolitical situations.
risks_headwinds.quote: See Chetan, the gold prices was playing a very important role in the last quarter, which everybody has visualized, because of the geopolitical situation.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to achieve around 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to increase its studded jewellery mix to between 12% and 15% by March 2028.
management_commitments.quote: And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach a total network of 51 stores, with the majority operating under the COCO model.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, Vikas here, our overall plan remains broadly unchanged we aim to reach a total of 51 stores, and the majority of these will continue to be under the Company-Owned, Company-Operated (COCO) model.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, and Maharashtra in the upcoming 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: Plans to Expand in Tier 2 & 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh , Gujarat and Maharashtra in upcoming 5 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to open three to four new stores in the current year.
management_commitments.quote: For this year, we have planned to open three to four new stores.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets targeting Jaipur in the next one to two years.
management_commitments.quote: We are targeting Jaipur in the next one to two years.

management_commitments.claim: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, the company aims to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5% by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

management_commitments.claim: By 2030, the company plans to have a total of around 51 stores.
management_commitments.quote: So, by 2030, we are planning to have a total of around 51 stores.

management_commitments.claim: Over the next three to five years, the company targets around 3% to 5% of topline revenue to come from the digital/online segment.
management_commitments.quote: So, over the long term, in the next three to five years, we are targeting around 3% to 5% of our topline revenue to come from this segment.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
